item.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
item.description: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts—Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng—debated regulation, open-source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

item.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
item.description: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from investors like SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Alitmeter Capital.

item.title: Mesh, Automattic’s CRM for everyone, comes to Android
item.description: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts app and relationship manager from Automattic is now an Android app.

item.title: Lovable confirms new $13.3B valuation, raises another $400M
item.description: This new funding comes after Lovable hit $500 million in annualized run rate revenue in June, the startup told TechCrunch.

item.description: Investors are still waiting for their share of the $250 million windfall, and VideoVerse co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav is now at the center of multiple legal cases.

item.title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
item.description: From the Pixel 11 series and a brand new competitor to Apple’s AirTag, here are all the announcements from the Made by Google 2026 event.

item.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith’s valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
item.description: Blacksmith says revenue has grown more than tenfold over the past year.

item.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
item.description: The U.S. VC firm still has more than 55% of its previous $650 million India fund available for deployment.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
item.description: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

item.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
item.description: Google also shared numbers of how people are actually using the chatbot, with 63% of Gemini users talking directly to the assistant using the voice feature. Plus, Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to Google.

item.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
item.description: One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."

item.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
item.description: River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.

item.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
item.description: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

item.title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
item.description: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

item.title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
item.description: Anthropic will extend support for watermarking AI generations for older models as well.

item.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
item.description: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI
item.description: On Monday, Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto about personal AI, largely about the possibilities for the "personal superintelligence" systems Meta AI is building.
